description: Plan-first multi-expert research that ranks long-term public-equity opportunities with sourced evidence, valuation scenarios and independent challenges.

defaultPrompt: Use $equity-council to rank long-term investments in an industry.
Use $equity-red-team to challenge an investment thesis.
Use $equity-update to refresh a saved industry ranking.
interface.longDescription: Eleven coordinated skills investigate industry economics, durable business quality, financial statements, capital allocation, risk, expectations and valuation. The council writes a plan, executes source-backed research, challenges its conclusions, audits calculations and ranks candidates with explicit uncertainty. Defaults to a 5–10 year compounding horizon. Includes a reproducible scenario calculator, research templates and forecast updates. Optional tip jar: https://ko-fi.com/quietengine. Tips are entirely optional.

name: equity-council
